description: This file implements functions for handling and extracting data from JSON objects using the json-c library. It provides utilities to select JSON objects or values by key, handle JSON arrays, and retrieve values with flexible parameters.

methods.name: json_object * dmjson_select_obj(json_object * jobj,const char * argv[])
methods.description: Selects a nested JSON object based on an array of keys.

methods.name: char * dmjson_print_value(json_object * jobj)
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a JSON value if its type is boolean, double, int, or string.

methods.name: char * ____dmjson_get_value_in_obj(json_object * mainjobj,const char * argv[])
methods.description: Retrieves the value within a JSON object based on an array of keys.

methods.name: char * __dmjson_get_value_in_obj(json_object * mainjobj,int argc,...)
methods.description: Wrapper that accepts a variable argument list of keys to retrieve a value from a JSON object.

methods.name: json_object * __dmjson_get_obj(json_object * mainjobj,int argc,...)
methods.description: Wrapper that accepts a variable argument list of keys to retrieve a nested JSON object.

methods.name: json_object * ____dmjson_select_obj_in_array_idx(json_object * mainjobj,json_object ** arrobj,int index,const char * argv[])
methods.description: Selects an object in an array within a JSON structure based on index and key path.

methods.name: json_object * __dmjson_select_obj_in_array_idx(json_object * mainjobj,json_object ** arrobj,int index,int argc,...)
methods.description: Wrapper for selecting array element with variable key arguments and index.

methods.name: char * ____dmjson_get_value_in_array_idx(json_object * mainjobj,json_object ** arrobj,int index,const char * argv[])
methods.description: Gets a value from a JSON array within the object, based on index and key path.

methods.name: char * __dmjson_get_value_in_array_idx(json_object * mainjobj,json_object ** arrobj,char * defret,int index,int argc,...)
methods.description: Wrapper that retrieves a value from a JSON array with a default fallback.

methods.name: char * ____dmjson_get_value_array_all(json_object * mainjobj,const char * delim,const char * argv[])
methods.description: Concatenates all values in a JSON array matching given key path, separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: char * __dmjson_get_value_array_all(json_object * mainjobj,const char * delim,int argc,...)
methods.description: Wrapper to get all values from a JSON array as a delimited string.
